---
title: "ReproCoffee"
subtitle: "A journal club on all things reproducibility and open science"
---

ReproCoffee is a journal club series where we illustrate and discuss papers about all things reproducibility and open science – from methodology and statistics, to the way academia sets up good (and bad) incentives. Paper presentations last 10 to 15 minutes, followed by an informal discussion.

The initiative is run by Claudia Mazzuca, Beatrice Valentini, Chiara Fini and Davide Crepaldi.

We meet monthly, online, so you're welcome from any corner of the world you currently sit on. To take part, you just need to complete [this form](https://forms.gle/vkSYc6XXtZmrZFH47), and you'll receive an email with a reminder and a link to take part in the event a few days before it happens.

You can reach us collectively at [reprocoffee@itrn.org](mailto:reprocoffee@itrn.org); one of us will always be there for you. Ah, and we also [tweet](https://twitter.com/ReproCoffee), so that's also a nice way to stay in touch.

[<i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i> Register for ReproCoffee](https://forms.gle/vkSYc6XXtZmrZFH47){.btn .btn-primary}
